fact: PARIVISION benched Vyacheslav “slaxejezzz” Vinokurov. The team says he remains part of PARIVISION, is available for loan, and is not for sale.
impact: Removed from the stated main roster; do not confuse with a confirmed release or completed loan.

fact: PARIVISION announced Abay “HObbit” Khassenov joined its main roster permanently, after an earlier summer stand-in stint.
impact: Changes the announced starting lineup ahead of the Finals; earlier stand-in dates are not specified here.

fact: Legacy announced Andrei “arT” Piovezan as its new IGL (“O @arTcsgo é nosso novo IGL! Seja bem-vindo!”), filling the spot left by lux.
impact: arT joins dumau/latto/n1ssim/saadzin for 2026; TWC26 Finals roster as of Sep 24 also lists try (RC-004).

fact: Legacy announced Santino “try” Rigal has joined Legacy (“Agora o @TRYZSE1 é Legacy!”), completing the swap that sent saadzin to Imperial.
impact: Restores the dumau/latto/try core; try replaces saadzin as AWPer for the run-up to the TWC26 Finals.

fact: Aurora announced Jimi “Jimpphat” Salo has joined the team (“Welcome to Aurora, Jimpphat!”).
impact: Aurora pivoted to an international roster; Jimpphat is in the Sep 7 Valve VRS ranked roster for Aurora (ML-035).

fact: Aurora announced Damjan “kyxsan” Stoilkovski as its captain (“Welcome, kyxsan! It's him. That's the captain.”), days after Falcons benched him.
impact: Completes Aurora's rebuild (with ash as coach, announced Jul 3); kyxsan leads the TWC26 finalist lineup.

sources.label: Aurora CS2 official X post — ash named head coach (Jul 3, 2026)

fact: Falcons announced karrigan has joined its CS2 roster (“Welcome to Falcons CS @karriganCSGO”), minutes after a roster statement benching kyxsan.
impact: kyxsan later surfaced at Aurora (RC-006); karrigan IGLs the TWC26 finalist Falcons lineup.
